items.item_text: CA RN and CA NP License- required
5+ years of exp as an oncology certified nurse (experience in infusion center is a plus)-preferred
BLS certification from American Red Cross or American Heart Association- required
Will consider a new grad with relevant nursing experience ( NP1: $84.62/hourly)

The NP functions in an interdependet role by implementing the appropriate SPs in oncology urgent care as well as infusion center. By using the SPs the NP is able to evaluate patients with a variety of oncological diagnoses and emergencies. NP will change treatment regiment after observing signs and symptoms of illness, reactions to treatment, general behaviors and physical condition and determines if they are abnormal findings. The NP will provide and coordinate the care of patients, provide patient/family education, promote safe continuity of care. The NP also participates in the interdiscplinary and clinical rounds, provides education and support, as well as makes appropriate referrals.
MSN/ DNP in NP Specialty -required (Adult Acute Care NP Specialty - strongly preferred but will consider Adult NP, FNP or PCNP with extensive relevant Oncology exp)
2+ years of exp as a Nurse Practitioner -preferred
NP, State of CA NP Furnishing with Schedule II, Additional: NPI #, DEA #, Enrollment in PECOS, Enrollment in CURES-required
Document patient care in a concise and comprehensive manner -required
Ability to utilize excel, word and other software programs -required
Ability to establish and maintain cooperative and collaborative working relationships with administrative, clinical and academic personnel -required
Skill in working independently and following through with minimum direction -required
Demonstrate writing skills to compose logical, detailed and grammatically correct correspondence -required
